title: Исход 32 — Exodus 32
instructions: Choose the correct case form of the word in brackets to fill the blank. Every option is a real form of the same word — only the case differs.

cases.sentence: Увидев, что Моисей медлит спускаться с ___.
cases.translation: Seeing that Moses delayed in coming down from the mountain.
cases.explain: The preposition с meaning "down from" takes the genitive → горы.

cases.translation: …make us gods who will go before us.
cases.explain: Богов is the direct object of сделай (make); for an animate masculine plural the accusative equals the genitive → богов.

cases.sentence: Снимите золотые серьги с ваших ___, сыновей и дочерей.
cases.translation: Take off the golden earrings from your wives, sons, and daughters.
cases.explain: The preposition с meaning "off / from" takes the genitive → жён (genitive plural).

cases.sentence: …и сделал из этого золота литого тельца, придав ему вид ___.
cases.translation: …and made from this gold a molten calf, giving it shape with an engraving tool.
cases.explain: The instrument of the action (fashioned with an engraving tool) is expressed by the instrumental → резцом.

cases.translation: Aaron set up an altar before the calf.
cases.explain: The preposition перед (in front of) takes the instrumental → тельцом.

cases.translation: …they offered burnt offerings and peace offerings.
cases.explain: Жертвы is the direct object of принесли (brought); for this inanimate feminine plural the accusative equals the nominative → жертвы.

cases.translation: …but now I will go up to the Lord.
cases.explain: The preposition к (to / toward) takes the dative → Господу.

cases.sentence: …чтобы убить в ___ и стереть с лица земли?
cases.translation: …to kill them in the mountains and wipe them from the face of the earth?
cases.explain: The preposition в meaning "in" a location (no motion) takes the prepositional → горах (prepositional plural).

reading.ru: Увидев, что Моисей медлит спускаться с горы, народ собрался вокруг Аарона и сказал, «Послушай, сделай нам богов, которые пойдут перед нами, потому что мы не знаем, что приключилось с этим Моисеем, выведшим нас из Египта».
reading.question: Why did the people gather around Aaron?
options: Because Moses delayed on the mountain and they wanted gods to go before them
Because they wished to return to Egypt at once
reading.correct: Because Moses delayed on the mountain and they wanted gods to go before them
reading.explain: Seeing that Moses delayed coming down, the people gathered and asked Aaron to make them gods to go before them.

reading.ru: Аарон ответил им, «Снимите золотые серьги с ваших жен, сыновей и дочерей и принесите их мне».
reading.question: What did Aaron tell the people to bring him?
options: The golden earrings of their wives, sons, and daughters
reading.correct: The golden earrings of their wives, sons, and daughters
reading.explain: Aaron told them to take off the golden earrings of their wives, sons, and daughters and bring them to him.

reading.ru: Он взял то, что они принесли ему, и сделал из этого золота литого тельца, придав ему вид резцом.
reading.question: What did Aaron make from the gold?
options: A molten calf, shaped with an engraving tool
reading.correct: A molten calf, shaped with an engraving tool
reading.explain: Aaron made a molten calf from the gold, giving it shape with an engraving tool.

reading.ru: Моисей повернулся и спустился с горы с двумя каменными плитками свидетельства в руках, они были исписаны с обеих сторон, спереди и сзади.
reading.question: What did Moses carry down from the mountain?
options: Two stone tablets written on both sides
reading.correct: Two stone tablets written on both sides
reading.explain: Moses came down carrying the two stone tablets of the covenant, written on both sides.

reading.ru: Он взял сделанного ими тельца и расплавил его в огне.
reading.question: What did Moses do with the calf?
options: He melted it in the fire
He buried it in the sand
He gave it to the Levites
He set it on the altar
reading.correct: He melted it in the fire
reading.explain: Moses took the calf they had made and melted it in the fire.

reading.ru: Левиты сделали, как повелел Моисей, и в тот день из народа погибло около трех тысяч человек.
reading.question: About how many people died that day?
reading.explain: The Levites did as Moses commanded, and about three thousand people died that day.
